poly.desc: Bets cheap long shots (and some favourites) on BTC every 5 min, $1 a bet
poly.name: Bot A: original strategy
poly.rule: Bets any side the model thinks is underpriced, favourites and underdogs. Can bet both sides in one round.

poly.desc: Bets only the favourite (45–70¢) on BTC, one $1 bet per round
poly.name: Bot B: favourites only
poly.rule: Only bets the side priced 45¢ to 70¢ (the favourite), and at most one bet per round.

poly.desc: Same as Bot A on BTC, but bigger: $3 bets from $60
poly.name: Bot C: Bot A strategy, $3 bets
poly.rule: Same rules as Bot A, but with a $60 bank and $3 per bet. Restarted 3 Nov, 1:23 AM PKT (old data cleared).

poly.desc: Bot A's strategy on Solana every 5 min, $1 a bet
poly.name: Bot D: Bot A strategy on Solana
poly.rule: Bot A's exact rules on Polymarket's Solana 5-minute Up/Down rounds. $20 bank, $1 bets. Started 3 Nov, 1:29 AM PKT.

poly.desc: Bot C's strategy on Solana every 5 min, $3 a bet
poly.name: Bot E: Bot C strategy on Solana
poly.rule: Bot C's exact rules on Polymarket's Solana 5-minute Up/Down rounds. $60 bank, $3 bets. Started 3 Nov, 1:29 AM PKT.

degen.desc: Real $20 burner wallet. Buys safer Solana memecoins, stop -25%, half off at +50%, 20% trail
degen.name: Degen live wallet (real money)
degen.rule: Entry: 2h+ old, $100k+ liquidity, $40k+ volume, top 10 under 30%, LP locked, RugCheck clean. 25% of equity per trade, max 3 positions.

degen.desc: Snipes brand-new pump.fun launches with early momentum, exits in minutes. $3 paper bets
degen.name: Degen sniper (paper)
degen.rule: Buys launches with 15+ unique buyers and strong buy pressure in the first minute; skips dev sells, bundles and repeat ruggers.

degen.desc: Swings established memecoins (TRUMP, USELESS): buys dips, sells bounces. Paper only
degen.name: Degen meme swing (paper)
degen.rule: Watches TRUMP, USELESS and buys a dip from the recent high, sells on the bounce or stop.
